## 近期结论
- **e010_selector_seed_threshold_sensitivity** (DONE / negative): 证伪 hypothesis：e009 selector 不是 seed/threshold-stable deployment rule。全量汇总 5 seeds × 9 threshold 组合，不 cherry-pick；平均 regret 小但 replication-level failure risk 高。`pilot_corr_selector`: mean_delta_vs_best_fixed≈0.00408、median_delta_vs_best_fixed=0、mean_delta_vs_fixed_partial≈-0.00255、vs independent≈-0.00403、loss_rate≈0.422、negative_failure_rate≈0.357、high_positive_loss_rate≈0.428、worst_cell_delta≈0.0832；`pilot_corr_severity_selector` 数值几乎相同（mean_delta_vs_best_fixed≈0.00408、loss_rate≈0.422、negative_failure_rate≈0.356、high_positive_loss_rate≈0.428、worst_cell_delta≈0.0832）。因此 e009/e010 只能写成 mean-level condition-specific observation，不能写 seed-threshold-stable deployable Stage 1 selector。← 基于 `e009_regime_aware_estimator_selection`
